summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands-on experience across mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and embedded firmware, from CAD-modeled fixtures and EAGLE PCB layouts to bare-metal STM32 control loops. Built and integrated robot platforms end to end, deriving kinematic models in ROS 2 and MoveIt, driving servo actuation over UART/I2C/SPI, and validating with ToF and IMU sensing in Python and C++.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and hardware integration end to end.
Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control, integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through calibration and resolution tuning.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to an STM32 over UART.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance display.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination between vision and control loops.

projects.name: ABB RobotStudio Automation Simulation
bullets: Designed and simulated a full ABB RobotStudio workcell for an end-to-end press-to-packing assembly pipeline, including CAD-modeled fixtures.
Programmed in RAPID with TCP socket-based pose acquisition and interrupt-driven press-bench logic; validated full-cycle repeatability.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand-computed full forward kinematic chains for a 6-DoF UR5e and a 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.
Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on a physical UR5e via the UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at under 2mm.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++ driving five servos with range-gated contact detection in a voice-controlled pick-and-place system.
Resolved 11 hardware integration failures (servo brown-out, false positives, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
